note: Every request the gap build made, in order, and each response as read (trimmed to the fields the build uses). build-gaps --check replays these.

steps.tool: street list for the public-text checks
steps.soql: SELECT street_name AS s WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY street_name ORDER BY street_name LIMIT 500 OFFSET 0

steps.tool: street list for the public-text checks
steps.soql: SELECT street_name AS s WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY street_name ORDER BY street_name LIMIT 500 OFFSET 500

steps.tool: street list for the public-text checks
steps.soql: SELECT street_name AS s WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY street_name ORDER BY street_name LIMIT 500 OFFSET 1000

steps.tool: street list for the public-text checks
steps.soql: SELECT street_name AS s WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY street_name ORDER BY street_name LIMIT 500 OFFSET 1500

steps.tool: gap catalog: Forestry removals by status
steps.soql: SELECT status_code, status_description, count(*) AS whole, sum(case(street IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS no_street, sum(case(contractor_cost > 0,1,true,0)) AS cc, sum(case(end_date IS NOT NULL,1,true,0)) AS has_end WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' GROUP BY status_code, status_description ORDER BY status_code, status_description LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Complete removals: dates covered
steps.soql: SELECT min(created_datetime) AS min_created_datetime, max(created_datetime) AS max_created_datetime WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code = 999 LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Complete removals with no street, by year
steps.soql: SELECT date_extract_y(created_datetime) AS y, count(*) AS whole, sum(case(street IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS part WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code = 999 GROUP BY y ORDER BY y LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Complete removals since a year ago
steps.soql: SELECT count(*) AS whole, sum(case(street IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS part, sum(case(street IS NULL AND ward IS NULL AND civic_league IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS no_loc WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code = 999 AND created_datetime >= '2025-11-10T00:00:00' LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Complete removals ending in the last year: end date vs created
steps.soql: SELECT count(*) AS whole, sum(case(date_trunc_ymd(end_date) < date_trunc_ymd(created_datetime),1,true,0)) AS before, sum(case(date_trunc_ymd(end_date) = date_trunc_ymd(created_datetime),1,true,0)) AS same WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code = 999 AND end_date >= '2025-11-10T00:00:00' AND end_date < '2026-11-10T00:00:00' LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Complete removals, all time: end date vs created
steps.soql: SELECT count(*) AS whole, sum(case(date_trunc_ymd(end_date) < date_trunc_ymd(created_datetime),1,true,0)) AS before, sum(case(date_trunc_ymd(end_date) = date_trunc_ymd(created_datetime),1,true,0)) AS same WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code = 999 AND end_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

steps.tool: gap catalog: Removals with status New Work Order or On-Going
steps.soql: SELECT count(*) AS whole, sum(case(end_date IS NOT NULL,1,true,0)) AS with_end WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code in (2, 4) LIMIT 100
SELECT created_datetime WHERE area = 'Forestry' AND primary_task_description = 'Removal' AND status_code in (2, 4) ORDER BY created_datetime, work_order_number LIMIT 1 OFFSET 174
SELECT problem_description AS v, count(*) AS n WHERE area = 'Forestry' GROUP BY problem_description ORDER BY n DESC, problem_description LIMIT 200

steps.tool: gap catalog: city trees with no usable trunk size
steps.soql: SELECT count(*) AS whole, sum(case(trunk_diameter_range IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS no_range, sum(case(trunk_diameter IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS no_dia, sum(case((trunk_diameter IS NULL OR trunk_diameter <= 0) AND trunk_diameter_range IS NULL,1,true,0)) AS no_usable WHERE (common_name IS NULL OR common_name != 'PRIVATE TREES') LIMIT 100
SELECT date_and_time, organization, type WHERE date_and_time >= '2026-11-10T00:00:00' ORDER BY date_and_time LIMIT 25

body.name: City Tree Inventory
body.description: This dataset shows all city-managed trees, the majority of which are located on public property, lining streets, or in right of ways. The original inventory of these trees was conducted in the late 1990s/early 2000s by the Norfolk Master Gardeners. No official re-inventory has been conducted since then by City officials or ISA Certified Arborists, however, tree records in this dataset have been and are being updated over time by City Staff. This dataset will be updated in the Open Data Portal every weekday.

If available, the approximate trunk diameter range of the tree. This field is in the process of being updated over time.
The longitude coordinate of the tree.
The latitude coordinate of the tree.

body.name: Public Meeting Notices
body.description: The public meeting notices dataset includes a listing of public meetings conducted by the City of Norfolk. The date, time, location, address, and links to the meeting video, agenda, and minutes are included. The meetings listed in this dataset include, but are not limited to, City Council Work Session and Formal Session, Planning Commission, Board of Zoning Appeals, and Architectural Review Board meetings. This dataset will be updated twice-daily on weekdays.

columns.description: The date and time of the public meeting.

The link to the primary details page for the public meeting.

The link to the summary of the meeting.
The link to the meeting minutes.
A link to the meeting video.

body.name: Address Information
body.description: The Address Information Resource is a compilation of information related to active and pending addresses in the City of Norfolk.  It provides a consolidated source to allow for quick and easy access to information about an address including details related to school districts, municipal services, planning, public safety, and civic leadership.  It is one of the main data resources that provides content for the Norfolk AIR website (https://air.norfolk.gov/#/).
body.attribution: City of Norfolk's Information Technology Department

body.name: Significant Trees
body.description: Volunteers with the Norfolk Master Gardeners gather this data about significant trees in Norfolk.  The data collected about these trees includes diameter, height, canopy spread, general location and species.  The data is updated every five years.
body.attribution: Recreation, Parks & Open Space (Parks and Forestry Operations)

body.name: STORM | System to Track, Organize, Record, and Map
body.description: This dataset provides an extract from Norfolk's STORM application.  STORM, an acronym for System to Track, Organize, Record and Map, captures data collected by residents and city staff during and after inclement weather events.  The app captures incidents such as flooded streets, damaged trees, disabled vehicles, downed cable lines, etc. This dataset provides a record of reported events entered into STORM beginning in 2010; the dataset is updated during and after weather events.
body.attribution: City of Norfolk, Department of Information Technology

body.name: Work Orders
body.description: This dataset contains data on Work Orders performed by field crews from the Department of Parks & Recreation, the Department of Transportation, and the Environmental Storm Water Management and Streets & Bridges Divisions of the Department of Public Works. The data comes from the city’s implementation of CentralSquare’s Enterprise Asset Management platform, also known as Lucity. This dataset is updated daily on weekdays.
body.attribution: Departments of Parks and Recreation, Public Works, and Transportation

body.name: Tree Planting Program
body.description: Recreation, Parks and Open Space’s Bureau of Parks and Urban Forestry plants hundreds of trees each year along city streets, within city parks, and on other city properties.  This dataset gives pertinent tree species information, shows important geographic information about which parts of Norfolk are receiving trees in a given year, and historical data about planting date.  City staff utilizes Microsoft excel to track tree planting information. This dataset will show where the City of Norfolk plants its trees on city owned properties.  This data is updated annually.
body.attribution: Parks and Forestry Operations, Recreation, Parks and Open Spaces
